ORIGINAL YIELD COLUMN DESCRIPTION: Straw (for crops) or grass (for grassland) dry mass. Grams per square meter per year. Straw: plot combine sampling, then drying of sample; grass: hand sampling then drying of sample.
Grain (for crops) or corn (shredded) dry mass. Grams per square meter per year. Grain: plot combine sampling, then drying of sample.

Crops were harvested with a plot combine within an area of 17.5 m² (1.75 m × 10 m) at each sampling distance. For the calculation of dry matter, parts of the harvested crop were dried in an oven at 60 °C until a constant mass was reached.
